items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1957-04-16
items.q: The two girls sing and we six played.

ctx.x: Just one of them things. We just stayed right there. Well, who was this guy, Northscog? Who? Northscog. Did you know a guy called Northscog? Because some of those records came out on the Northscog label. No. You didn't know Northscog. No, no, no. The only man you dealt with was the Spikes brothers. Spikes brothers, that's who we dealt with.
The two girls sing and we six played.
Well, the two girls who sang, did they bring in those girls or did you know those girls?
